name: Starship 1
notes: Single source. Every one of the 10 devices comes from the IC parts list in IPC-085, and that is the only printing of this manual in the corpus that carries the list. No component-location drawing has been read. Nothing here has been checked against a second source, which is the test every other board on this site has passed, and the board page says so.

The grid spacing is nominal — the designators are what the parts list gives, but nothing has measured the board. Rows run R to A and columns 1 to 11; the row span is the standard Atari alphabet between the outermost letters seen, so rows with no device on them are still drawn as positions the board has.
conflicts: 4 device name(s) could not be recovered and are not placed: B11 (8926), B4 (8926), E10 (14081), R10 (14081). Each is an OCR of a part number whose function number does not name anything the packaging table knows, and with only one printing there is no second reading to repair it from.
1 designator(s) fall outside the board's grid and are not placed: B19 (555).
